title: 第3章 随心随性西门二姐第4章 江南杏林大儒
slug: 大罗邪仙苟在剑门当药师
content_zh:
但是，西门三丝内心还是觉得有什么地方不对劲。
哪里呢？
她目光那么一扫茶几上的这壶茶，对呀……
“你这悟道茶，跟那药池，效果如何？”
“差不多！”度凌实话实说。
这两种促进修行人悟道方式的“药疗”之术，效果大差不差，都是“道心”欠临门一脚之时，助修行人突破道心之用。
修行路上，悟道最难。
所以，悟道之辅助，才如此珍贵。
这也是他纵然设下如此严苛的条件，他的药园，依然有许多弟子前来的根本原因。
因为这里，不管是喝茶还是洗澡，都对修行者的悟道，大有帮助。
“既然效果差不多，你为什么不让我妹妹喝你一杯茶，而非得让她洗澡？”
洗澡，才会面临“先光pp”和“后光pp”的两难选择。
不洗澡不就不需要这个选择了吗？
你明明可以直接转换成不洗澡，只喝茶，你偏偏让她妹妹在“先光pp”和“后光pp”中作选择，到底是不是有意为之？
“因为……有一个记载！女人喝了悟道茶，身与道融，生理机能会发生改变，极有可能生不出孩子。”度凌道：“若是你决意让你妹妹从此不嫁人生子，不妨让她喝上一杯！”
“典籍中记载的悟道茶，可没有你说的这种后遗症。”西门三丝眼珠轻轻地转。
度凌手中茶杯也轻轻在掌中旋转：“典籍记载有千千万，版本也各不相同，立足点也是各有千秋，兴许在修行人眼中，有无子女本身并不重要，也许是记载版本有误，当然，想验证也是可以的，比如说姑娘你就可以以身入局，进行一个验证。”
“我以身入局？”
“是啊，你今日就可以喝上一杯悟道茶，然后找个男人试试，且看能不能生出孩子，若是可以，那就证明我看到的这则记载有误，我马上修改条款，各路师姐师妹们还是别洗澡了，直接喝茶多好啊。”度凌道：“如此一来，规则就通透了，从此不会再有人说我度凌恶趣味，强分男女，贪财好色，三小姐你呢……也纠正了典籍中的一则谬误，从此名垂修行史，岂不两全其美？”
西门三丝瞠目结舌……

心头一堆的小火苗在那里蹿啊蹿，偏偏找不着任何突破口。
脚一蹬，头发一扬，身化剑形青波，冲天上。
度凌嘴角露出一丝痞笑，随手拿起躺椅上的一本书，这本书，只是闲书，书名《九州风物记》，记载的是这方天地，各地的风土人情。
再说西门三丝。
饱含怒意出掌教峰，带着一肚皮的迷茫回圣女峰。
圣女峰顶，一块石碑。
古朴沧桑态，一字断云霞。
是的，碑上只有一个字：杀。
简简单单一个字，却让这座圣女峰上方，没有半点云霞，不仅仅是今日，千年来的任何一天，别的地方四季轮回，阴晴难定，而这里，永远都是晴，永远都是秋。
这就是这块剑门“杀碑”之特异。
这也是彰显剑门之风的标志。
但有愁云，一剑斩之。
content_en:
However, Ximen Sansi still felt that something was wrong.
Where?
She glanced at the pot of tea on the coffee table, right...
"How effective are your Enlightenment Tea and that medicine pool?"
"Almost!" Du Ling said truthfully.
These two "medicine" techniques that promote the way practitioners realize the Tao are very different in their effects. They are both used to help practitioners break through the Tao heart when the "Tao heart" is in need of a decisive kick.
On the road of spiritual practice, enlightenment is the most difficult thing.
That’s why the aid of enlightenment is so precious.
This was also the fundamental reason why many disciples came to his medicine garden even though he set such stringent conditions.
Because here, whether drinking tea or taking a bath, it is of great help to the practitioner's enlightenment.
"Since the effect is almost the same, why don't you let my sister drink a cup of tea from you instead of letting her take a bath?"
When taking a bath, you will face the dilemma of "lighting the pp first" and "lighting the pp last".
Wouldn’t this option be unnecessary if you don’t take a shower?
You could obviously switch to not taking a shower and only drinking tea, but you let her sister choose between "lighting pp first" and "lighting pp last". Is this intentional?
"Because... there is a record! When a woman drinks Tao Enlightenment Tea, her body and Tao will merge, her physiological functions will change, and she will most likely not be able to give birth to children." Du Ling said: "If you are determined to let your sister never marry and have children, you might as well let her drink a cup!"
"The Enlightenment Tea recorded in the classics does not have the kind of sequelae you mentioned." Ximen Sansi rolled his eyes gently.
The tea cup in Du Ling's hand also rotated gently in his palm: "There are thousands of records in the classics, and the versions are different. Each has its own point of view. Maybe in the eyes of practitioners, having children or not is not important in itself. Maybe the record version is wrong. Of course, you can verify it. For example, if you are a girl, you can enter the game and conduct a verification."
"Am I involved in the game?"
"Yes, you can drink a cup of Enlightenment Tea today, and then find a man to try it, and see if you can give birth to a child. If you can, it proves that the record I saw is wrong. I will change the terms immediately. Senior sisters and sisters from all walks of life, it is better not to take a shower and just drink tea. How good." Du Ling said: "In this way, the rules will be clear. From now on, no one will say that I have bad tastes, separate men and women, and are greedy for money and lust. How about you, Miss Three... you have also corrected a fallacy in the classics. From now on, you will be famous in the history of practice. Wouldn't you have the best of both worlds?"
Ximen Sansi was dumbfounded...
A bunch of little flames were jumping up and down in my heart, but I couldn't find any breakthrough.
He kicked his feet, raised his hair, and transformed into sword-shaped green waves, rising into the sky.
A sly smile appeared at the corner of Du Ling's mouth, and he picked up a book on the recliner. This book was just a casual book. The title of the book was "Jiuzhou Fengwu Ji", which recorded the customs and customs of this world.
Let’s talk about Ximen Sansi.
He left the Headmaster's Peak full of anger and returned to the Saint's Peak full of confusion.
On the top of Saintess Peak, a stone tablet.
Simple and vicissitudes of life, one word breaks the clouds.
Yes, there is only one word on the monument: kill.
A simple word, but there is no clouds above the Saintess Peak, not just today, but any day in the past thousand years. In other places, the four seasons are reincarnated, and it is difficult to determine whether it is cloudy or sunny, but here, it is always sunny and always autumn.
This is the specialness of this Jianmen "Killing Monument".
This is also a symbol of the style of Jianmen.
But if there is a cloud of sorrow, cut it off with one sword.
